# KAUTUSAN BLG. 05, Series of 1990

**Naming of National Road as Eulalio A. Glinga National Road**

## Summary

This ordinance officially names the National Road in Pitogo, Quezon as the Eulalio A. Glinga National Road, in recognition of his service as Presidente Municipal. The ordinance aims to honor his contributions to the municipality.

## Key Provisions

1.  The National Road in Pitogo, Quezon is officially named the Eulalio A. Glinga National Road.
2.  The ordinance takes effect thirty (30) days after its approval.
